column3: “the veil” renders “parokhet,” the curtain, and “the mercy seat” renders “kapporet,” the atonement cover (throughout the chapter).
“the holy linen tunic” renders “a linen tunic of holiness,” and “attired with” renders “wrap himself with”; NASB puts “these are holy garments” in parentheses.
“the scapegoat” renders “Azazel,” a word whose meaning is uncertain (also in verses 10 and 26).
“a firepan” renders “a censer (mahtah),” and “finely ground sweet incense” renders “fine incense of spices.”
“on the ark of the testimony” renders “on the testimony.”
“no one” renders “no man (adam),” and “that he may make atonement” renders “and he has made atonement.”
“lay” renders “lean (press),” and “a man who stands in readiness” renders a rare word (itti) whose meaning is uncertain.
“a solitary land” renders “a land cut off (gezerah).”
